title: Ceramics Membership with Gas Reduction Firing
source_quote: All members use studio clay bodies, fired in either cone six oxidation or cone ten reduction.
evidence_sentence: The membership page states members have access to firings in cone six oxidation or cone ten reduction.
evidence_quote: All members use studio clay bodies, fired in either cone six oxidation or cone ten reduction.
summary: A $185/month membership provides studio access 9am–9pm daily with inclusion in regular Open Studio hours where the ceramics staff fire bisque, cone ten reduction, and cone six oxidation kilns. Clay and firing are charged at student rates.
how_to_join: Contact Tom O'Malley at 508-753-8183 x304 or tomalley1@worcester.edu to request an application.
